description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling date ranges, working hours, date overrides, out-of-office periods, and their processing, merging, intersecting, and subtracting within a scheduling or availability context.

methods.name: getAdjustedTimezone
methods.description: Determines the correct timezone for a given date considering travel schedules and time zone changes.

methods.name: processWorkingHours
methods.description: Processes and merges working hours into date ranges, handling overlaps and DST adjustments.

methods.name: processDateOverride
methods.description: Converts a date override into a date range considering timezone and travel schedules.

methods.name: processOOO
methods.description: Creates a date range for an out-of-office date.

methods.name: buildDateRanges
methods.description: Builds date ranges for availability, including working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods, and filters out overlaps.

methods.name: groupByDate
methods.description: Groups date ranges by calendar date.

methods.name: intersect
methods.description: Finds common overlapping periods across multiple date ranges.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts excluded date ranges from source ranges, splitting ranges as needed.

methods.name: mergeOverlappingRanges
methods.description: Merges overlapping date ranges into consolidated ranges.
